plan: My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding my true value or slightly above my true value is generally a good strategy to ensure I win when it's profitable. Given my value is $42, I will bid $42.1 to ensure I win if the second highest bid is $42 or less, securing a profit.

My private value is $29. In a Vickrey auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy, as it maximizes profit regardless of other bidders' actions. Bidding below my value risks losing to a bid I would have been happy to beat, while bidding above my value risks winning and paying more than the item is worth to me. Therefore, I will bid my true value to maximize my profit.

My value is $48.
